Lina Haddad

Biotechnology student working in the lab and in code, with a focus on bioinformatics.

Open to internships, training and research

See projectsDownload CV

About me

I study biotechnology and use computational tools to answer biological questions. I like following a sample all the way: from the bench, to the sequencer, to a figure I can explain.

I am building my bioinformatics skills project by project, with documented code and results that others can repeat.

Genomics / Transcriptomics / Microbial evolution / Structure-based drug design

Education

BSc Biotechnology, Al Noor University, Amman. GPA 3.7 / 4.0

  1. 2023–24

    Foundations

    General biology, chemistry, lab safety and microscopy.

  2. 2024–25

    Molecular biology

    DNA extraction, PCR and cloning. First scripts in Python.

  3. 2025–26

    Genomics and data

    Linux, R and biostatistics. First RNA-seq analysis.

  4. 2026–27

    Research

    Graduation project on soil bacteria, from isolation to 16S analysis.

Technical and laboratory skills

At the bench

  • DNA and RNA extraction
  • PCR and qPCR
  • Gel electrophoresis
  • SDS-PAGE and Western blot
  • Bacterial transformation
  • Cell culture
  • ELISA
  • Spectrophotometry

At the computer

Programming
Python, R, Bash, Git
Sequence analysis
BLAST, FastQC, HISAT2, samtools, GATK
Statistics and plots
DESeq2, ggplot2, pandas
Structure and evolution
PyMOL, AutoDock Vina, MAFFT, IQ-TREE

Bioinformatics projects

Differential expression from RNA-seq

Which genes respond to the treatment? Six treated samples against six controls, using a panel of immune genes. 113 of 225 genes changed (p below 0.05, at least 2-fold).

FastQC → HISAT2 → featureCounts → DESeq2

CodeReport

Variant calling pipeline

Which variants does this sample carry? Exome reads aligned to GRCh38 and filtered at QUAL 30. 41 rare missense variants were left for review.

BWA → samtools → GATK → VEP

CodeReport

16S rRNA phylogeny

Where does the isolate sit among known species? Soil isolate B7 groups with B. subtilis, with 99.2% identity and bootstrap support of 98.

BLAST → MAFFT → IQ-TREE

CodeReport

Molecular docking

How does the ligand sit in the active site? The best pose scored −8.4 kcal/mol and forms four hydrogen bonds in the active site.

PDB → AutoDock Vina → PyMOL

CodeReport

Homes and small shops with colour, storage and a clear plan.

I handle the whole project, from the first measurement to the last cushion, for apartments, kitchens and cafes.

Marina Apartment

A couple moving from a villa wanted the apartment to feel calm and lived in. Deep green seating anchors the room, and the brass is kept to thin lines.

Living room. Dubai, 2024. 145 m², finished in 14 weeks.

  • Sage limewash
  • Forest velvet
  • Oiled oak
  • Brushed brass
  • Terracotta linen

Barsha Kitchen

The old kitchen had 1.9 m of worktop. The new plan has 6.4 m, with everything in daily use between knee and shoulder height.

Kitchen and island. Dubai, 2023. 28 m², finished in 6 weeks.

  • Slate blue lacquer
  • Fluted petrol oak
  • Glazed tile
  • White quartz
  • Aged brass

Palm Guest Suite

A guest room that also hosts long stays. Panelling hides the wardrobe doors and the cables for both bedside lights.

Bedroom. Dubai, 2023. 46 m², finished in 8 weeks.

  • Clay panelling
  • Plum upholstery
  • Walnut
  • Rosewood wool
  • Ivory linen

Saffron Coffee Bar

The bar faces the door, so the queue stays inside the shop and away from the tables. Arched niches replaced three closed windows.

Cafe, 24 seats. Sharjah, 2022. 85 m², finished in 11 weeks.

  • Saffron plaster
  • Bottle green tile
  • Smoked oak
  • Rust leather
  • Steel

About me

I have designed interiors in the Emirates since 2018. I start from how people move and where things are stored, then choose colour and material. Clients get one price list and one weekly update.

How I work

  1. Visit and brief

    Measured survey, photos and a written brief with your budget.

    1 week

  2. Concept

    Layout options, mood and a first material board.

    2 weeks

  3. Design package

    Drawings, lighting plan, furniture list and prices from suppliers.

    3 weeks

  4. Build and styling

    Contractor follow-up, deliveries and final styling.

    4 to 12 weeks
